title: And I Serve: Biplane pilot
description: When Senior Airman Phil Owens isn't working as a crew chief in the 192nd Aircraft Maintenance Squadron, he's flying tours of Acadia National Park in Maine. Just two weeks after starting this, his first commercial flying job, he experienced catastrophic engine failure and had to perform and emergency off-airport landing. Owens tells his story in this edition of "And I Serve".
keywords: crash, ANG, commercial, serve, survive, biplane, VAANG, Air National Guard, pilot, job

This is my first commercial flying job.

- Well we're flying over here in Maine,

The type of aircraft I fly here is a tail wheel

And so once those kind of finally set down

onto the top wing there.
So after we flipped over, of course I unbuckled there
and checked on the passengers up front of me.
There were two passengers that day.
You know, looked at both of them
